name: sdlc-suite
description: Product & engineering lifecycle roles: product-manager, tech-lead, qa-engineer, engineering-lead, ux-designer, platform-engineer, release-manager, document-manager, plus the shared document-templates library. Project-agnostic (configured per project by SDLC.md), rigor-aware, multi-surface, monorepo-aware, test-first, with standards enforced by automated checks and independent review, and work tracked in GitHub Issues (Feature → Story → Task) with checkpoints.
